description: This Python module provides functions for text correction and formatting of subtitle data, including grammar/spell correction, punctuation normalization, entity protection with spaCy, sentence casing, and OTT line wrapping. It includes public interfaces for correcting subtitle text, wrapping lines, and applying post-processing corrections on subtitle files.

methods.name: str _nfkc_normalize(text: str)
methods.description: Performs Unicode NFKC normalization on the input text, with exception handling.

methods.name: str _normalize_spaces(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace, replaces line endings, and collapses multiple spaces while preserving newlines.

methods.name: str _sentence_case(s: str)
methods.description: Converts the first alphabetic character in a string to uppercase, preserving other characters.

methods.name: Optional[Callable[[],any]] _load_spacy_model(lang: str)
methods.description: Lazily loads a spaCy language model based on ISO-639-1 code, with fallback options.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,bool]] _spacy_protect_entities(text: str, nlp_loader: Optional[Callable[[], any]])
methods.description: Splits text into tokens marking those that are part of named entities as protected spans.

methods.name: str _apply_language_tool(text: str, lang: str)
methods.description: Uses language_tool_python to correct text; falls back gracefully if unavailable.

methods.name: str _normalize_punctuation(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes spacing around punctuation marks without affecting timing tags.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Greedy wraps text into lines respecting maximum character count and line count constraints.

methods.name: str wrap_lines_for_ott(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2)
methods.description: Wraps subtitle cue text into OTT-friendly line lengths and number of lines.

methods.name: str correct_subtitle_text( text: str, lang: Optional[str] = None, *, protect_entities: bool = True, sentence_case: bool = True, use_language_tool: bool = True, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2, )
methods.description: Performs normalization, entity protection, sentence casing, language correction, punctuation normalization, and OTT wrapping on subtitle cue text.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Reads an SRT file, corrects each cue's text, and writes a new post-processed SRT file.

ctags.name: _wrap_text
ctags.pattern: /^def _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int, max_lines: int) -> List[str]:$/

ctags.name: correct_subtitle_text
ctags.signature: ( text: str, lang: Optional[str] = None, *, protect_entities: bool = True, sentence_case: bool = True, use_language_tool: bool = True, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2, )

ctags.name: wrap_lines_for_ott
ctags.pattern: /^def wrap_lines_for_ott(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2) -> str:$/
